baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive يُنَبَّؤُا governs the coordinated content بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: A consequential report arranges the human's forward advancement and later deferral into one inspectable temporal account.

activation_trace.role: News brought and reported supplies the consequential disclosure event that governs the paired acts.
Forward advance and precedence supply the account's beforeward or prioritized side.
Deferral to a later time supplies the account's postponed side.

changed_reading.before: The human is simply told about earlier and later deeds.
changed_reading.after: The passive disclosure delivers a consequential, ordered account of whatever the human advanced and whatever he deferred.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ is the recipient of disclosure, and قَدَّمَ can carry intentional movement toward a matter.
baseline_models.mechanism: Informing brings into awareness not bare chronology but the recipient's own ordering of intention: matters deliberately moved into action versus matters deliberately postponed.

activation_trace.role: Perception by seeing, sensing, or hearing makes the human a recipient brought into awareness.
A brought report provides the means by which that awareness becomes explicit.
Intentional turning toward a thing makes the forward side a chosen undertaking rather than a date label.
Postponement supplies the contrasting choice to hold something for later.

changed_reading.before: A report lists acts by when they occurred.
changed_reading.after: The human is made aware of the ordering he intended: what he moved into undertaking and what he chose to postpone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The قَدَّمَ / أَخَّرَ opposition can juxtapose precedent with what comes after or remains at the rear.
baseline_models.mechanism: The report can extend beyond a private timeline to an initiative-and-aftermath account: what the human established in advance and what remained for a later phase or for others after him.

activation_trace.role: Consequential reported news makes precedent and aftermath reportable together.
Precedent and advanced standing activate what was established ahead of later action.
A later or other member after the first opens the pair toward aftermath beyond the initial act.

changed_reading.before: The pair divides one life into earlier and later acts.
changed_reading.after: The pair may also divide initiative from aftermath: what the human set as a precedent and what remained in a later phase or reached others after him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The self that blames and possesses inward sight makes the external report a formal exposure of evidence the human already carries against himself.

activation_trace.role: The brought report remains the formal act of disclosure.
Perceptive awareness anchors the changed reading in the human recipient.
The thing's own self or essence identifies the witness and the accused as the same human self.
Blame for what merits reproach gives the self an accusatory function.
What lies within the self as reason and inward apprehension locates the evidence internally.
Insight of the heart makes that internal evidence consciously discernible.

structural_cues: 75:2 names a self-reproaching self, while 75:14-15 places discerning self-evidence before offered excuses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-blame, the self's inward contents, and heart-insight; I infer that these make informing a ratification and exposure of self-known evidence, not first acquisition of unknown facts. A live alternative is that inner awareness and the report remain separate witnesses.

changed_reading.before: An external informer supplies facts the human may not know.
changed_reading.after: The human is formally confronted with an account already legible within his reproaching and discerning self, so excuses cannot function as lack of knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same human's desire to violate bounds 'ahead of him' activates قَدَّمَ as a projected course of conduct, so the later report audits a chosen forward program as well as completed past acts.

activation_trace.role: Forward advance and precedence anchor the focus pair in prospective direction.
Intentional movement toward a matter makes that direction a chosen program.
Deferral provides the contrasting matters repeatedly held back.
Deviation from right and rupture of restraint supplies the character of the projected conduct.
What is in front and near supplies the explicit futureward field into which conduct is projected.

structural_cues: 75:5 repeats ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ and places his desired boundary-breaking أَمَامَهُ, before him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same human, transgressive rupture, and a field in front; I infer that their forward spatiality activates the focus's advancing as a continuing project. The live alternative is that أَمَامَهُ is an independent idiom and the focus pair is wholly retrospective.

changed_reading.before: The report concerns a closed archive of earlier and delayed acts.
changed_reading.after: The report exposes the futureward course the human chose to keep advancing and the matters he repeatedly put back.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flight is closed and the human reaches a fixed settlement immediately before notification; the report therefore functions as an unescapable terminal accounting rather than optional information.

activation_trace.role: Consequential reported news supplies the disclosure at the endpoint.
Flight and escape supply the option sought and then structurally denied.
Fixity and settlement close the route and turn the next report into an endpoint event.

structural_cues: 75:10 asks where escape lies, 75:11 denies a refuge, and 75:12 fixes the settlement toward the Lord immediately before 75:13.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted flight followed by fixed settlement; I infer that this sequence gives the passive report compulsory and jurisdictional force. A live alternative is that the sequence locates the report without changing its communicative function.

changed_reading.before: The human receives a report whose setting is unspecified.
changed_reading.after: At the destination from which no flight remains, the human is arraigned by a consequential account of what he advanced and deferred.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering dispersed units, reciting them, tracing them item after item, and clarifying their meaning supplies a process model for يُنَبَّؤُا: the account is assembled into sequence and made manifest.

activation_trace.role: The brought report is the focus event whose production becomes procedurally specified.
Precedence supplies one ordering relation among the assembled items.
Deferral supplies the later ordering relation among those items.
Joining dispersed material until it becomes one gathered whole supplies record assembly.
Reading and recitation supply ordered vocal disclosure of the gathered material.
Tracing one mark after another supplies itemwise sequence and prevents rearrangement.
Making meaning clear by speech or sign supplies the final explanatory function.

structural_cues: 75:16 blocks hurried tongue movement; 75:17-19 then orders gathering, recitation, following, and explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a nearby communication sequence; I analogically apply its gather-read-follow-explain order to the passive informing in 75:13. The materially live alternative is that 75:16-19 addresses a distinct recipient and process and should not specify the deed report.

changed_reading.before: The account arrives as an undifferentiated statement.
changed_reading.after: The human's dispersed forward and deferred matters are gathered into order, followed item by item, and then disclosed with their significance made clear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contrast between the immediate and the latter converts قَدَّمَ / أَخَّرَ from neutral chronology into an enacted hierarchy of preference: what was brought forward in concern versus what was pushed back.

activation_trace.role: Forward advance and precedence anchor the preferred, brought-forward side.
Deferral anchors what was relegated to later concern.
Hastening and bringing forward characterize the immediate object that receives priority.
The latter after the first supplies the explicitly contrasted horizon that is left behind.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 contrasts loving the immediate with leaving the latter, using affective and abandonment verbs rather than dates alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate/latter opposition governed by love and leaving; I infer that the focus pair records the human's lived priority order. The live alternative is that the contrast names two horizons without glossing what was advanced or deferred.

changed_reading.before: The report sorts deeds into earlier and later times.
changed_reading.after: The report reveals a preference ledger: what the human promoted into immediate concern and what he relegated to the latter horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired sequence of a negated affirmation and practice followed by enacted denial and turning away activates the focus pair as commission versus withheld obligation, not merely two time bins.

activation_trace.role: Intentional undertaking anchors what the human positively put into action.
Deferral anchors duties or responses held back from action.
Fulfillment of word and action, negated in the source, supplies a concrete non-performance.
Contradiction of truth supplies the contrary act that was positively performed.
Turning the back and withdrawing supplies active refusal rather than simple inactivity.

structural_cues: 75:31-32 balances two negated responses, 'did not affirm and did not pray,' against two enacted responses, 'denied and turned away.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit non-performance/performance syntax; I infer that it concretizes أَخَّرَ as what was withheld and قَدَّمَ as what was enacted. The live alternative is that these are examples inside a still purely chronological pair.

changed_reading.before: The human hears which deeds came first and last.
changed_reading.after: The account includes both what he enacted and what he withheld, including refusals that themselves became positive acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: A leaving that preserves a trace activates أَخَّرَ as residual aftermath: the account includes effects remaining behind after the actor moves on, paired with precedents launched ahead.

activation_trace.role: Consequential news makes residual effects part of what can be reported.
Precedent and advanced standing supply the initiative sent ahead.
The rear or posterior part supplies what remains behind the actor.
A trace preserved after leaving supplies the causal remainder that outlasts the immediate act.

structural_cues: 75:36 asks whether the human supposes he will be left without directed consequence, after the surah has displayed his refusals.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a branch in which leaving preserves an أثر and a verse denying that the human is simply left; I infer that the focus's rearward side can include effects the human leaves after himself. The live alternative is that 75:36 concerns only God's treatment of the human, not the human's own residues.

changed_reading.before: أَخَّرَ means only acts postponed until a later time.
changed_reading.after: أَخَّرَ can also open onto the reportable trace left behind, while قَدَّمَ names the precedent or initiative sent ahead.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it renders verbal accounting as a bodily route-map through branch-distant path, foot, forepart, and rear images. It remains anchored in the focus roots and gains same-root support from the legs and final driving in 75:29-30. Downstream prose should mark it as a spatial-material analogy, not as a lexical gloss of the sentence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ permits a front/rear activation, while branches of يُنَبَّؤُا and قَدَّمَ contribute path and stepping images.

activation_trace.role: A clear path leading toward an intended destination turns informing into route disclosure.
The stepping foot gives the forward side an embodied unit of movement.
The forepart or leading edge supplies the route's front.
The rear or posterior part supplies what trails behind on that route.
The bodily leg image materializes the route at the moment the legs are entwined.
Driving and impelling supplies compelled conveyance to the route's endpoint.

changed_reading.before: The human receives a static ledger of earlier and later entries.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the human is shown the route his acts formed, from forward steps to what trailed behind, as he is bodily driven to the endpoint.

strongest_changes: Self-reproach and inward sight revise the report from new information into formal exposure of self-known evidence.
The human's desire to violate bounds ahead of him makes the account prospective: it audits a chosen forward course, not only a closed past.
The immediate/latter contrast turns قَدَّمَ / أَخَّرَ into a hierarchy of lived priority.
Gathering, recitation, itemwise following, and explanation provide a procedural model for how the report becomes an ordered disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package repeatedly converted a simple temporal ledger into models of intention, self-witness, priority, omission, residual consequence, and compelled trajectory without requiring those models to collapse into one reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The commission/omission mapping is contextually strong but is not forced by the focus pair's morphology alone.
The communication sequence in 75:16-19 may be analogically illuminating while still addressing a distinct recipient and event.
The precedent, residual-trace, and embodied-route readings depend on branch-distant extensions and should remain exploratory or qualified.
